lines:
Execution order: step 13 of 13. Depends on Adashi task ID 22. Complete this prerequisite before starting.

Phase: final multi-user and backend parity gate.

Validate the completed roadmap using the same conformance suite for SQLite, text and server SQL:
- Cover every persisted domain, lifecycle transitions, references, snapshots, expectedVersion/readTokens, idempotency, schema upgrades, change notifications and read-only behavior.
- Test two users/processes with desktop and MCP: independent edits, conflicting updates/deletes, simultaneous creation, reconnects, service restarts and lost responses after commit.
- Verify authentication/authorization failures, project isolation, migration during active sessions, secret handling and backup/restore.
- Exercise all supported backend conversion directions with representative full projects, including drafts/proposals, history and QA evidence.
- Complete native desktop and real MCP end-to-end workflows for each backend, including refresh without discarding unsaved work.
- Update user documentation and formal architecture to match the implemented backend choices, setup, Git workflow and multi-user limitations.

Acceptance: recorded automated and native evidence shows that all three per-project backends work through the same adapter in desktop and MCP. Existing SQLite projects remain supported, Git collaboration retains valid edits, and server SQL provides reliable concurrent multi-user access.

data.title: Storage 13/13 — Verify multi-user SQL and parity across all storage backends
